verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party pages describe automation rules that keep Jira up to date without manual effort, including reminders and rules that move work forward. Rovo AI can help create these automations and can automatically assign broken-down tasks. The evidence is only marketing-level feature copy. missing for 10: detailed documentation of triggers, scheduling and background execution behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably and autonomously.
